assigned.title: Experiment 1a exists as a specification and not as something anyone can run
assigned.acceptance:
SPLIT FROM PW-0103 UNDER gpt-architect's ROUND-115 SECTION 5, which corrects a standing mistake in how this project has modelled that task: 'PW-0103 is NOT purely commander work. The final visual/compositing observation requires Diego's physical Windows machine. But preparing the experiment harness is engineering work Claude can do now.' PW-0103 keeps the OBSERVATION and stays blocked on hardware. This owns the thing he runs.

BUILD EXACTLY THE EXPERIMENT IN docs/DESKTOP_PLAYBACK.md SECTION 10, and nothing else. A bare Tauri window; a static HTML page with a semi-transparent gradient panel, a large button and a CSS spinner; transparent WebView2; a sibling child HWND below the webview in z-order; libmpv rendering into that child HWND via wid with vo=gpu-next,gpu, gpu-context=d3d11, hwdec=auto, terminal=no, osc=no, input-default-bindings=no, config=no; a local file; time-pos, pause, hwdec-current, avsync and friends polled and displayed live; the button toggling pause.

REQUIRED: NO Next.js, no adapter, no product code, no provider, no network dependency, no DRM routing, no packaging, no LGPL build. The spec says so and the reason is that every one of those would make a failure ambiguous.
REQUIRED: throwaway and small. Target under 300 lines of experiment-specific Rust. It lives outside the application's crates and is not wired into the product build.
REQUIRED: Windows CI COMPILES it, including the libmpv link, so the artifact handed over is known to build rather than hoped to. Type-checking is not enough for this one: the whole dependency is a native library.
REQUIRED: the commander receives a RUNNABLE ARTIFACT. He must not install Rust, build mpv, assemble dependencies, edit source, or become the build server. gpt's section 12 is explicit.
REQUIRED: a tiny evidence checklist covering the spec's pass criteria -- hardware decode with hwdec-current not 'no' AND Task Manager GPU Video Decode above zero, visible alpha compositing, the button receiving clicks, resize/drag keeping video and UI locked, a per-monitor DPI change, and properties streaming at a usable rate.
REQUIRED: IT MUST NOT CLAIM EXPERIMENT 1a PASS. Compilation is not the experiment. Nothing in this task may record a PW-0103 result.
REQUIRED: the test video is the commander's own local file, taken as an argument. A 4K60 HEVC or AV1 file is what the spec asks for because the hardware-decode criterion depends on it; the harness must say so and must not silently accept something that cannot test that criterion.

IF THE EXPERIMENT FAILS WHEN RUN: stop. Do not hack around a compositing failure. The D1 native-playback architecture decision goes back through architecture review, which is what the experiment is for.

OUT OF SCOPE: Experiment 1b, which the spec says comes after 1a passes and not before.
assigned.notes:
FILED ROUND 115. The enabling discovery is that libmpv2 6.0.0 TYPE-CHECKS for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc in this container with no native library present -- cargo check does not link -- so real mpv code can be written and verified here before it ever reaches a runner. The same trick that made PL-0734 verifiable.

Linking is the part that still needs CI: the job must fetch a prebuilt libmpv for Windows. That dependency is for the EXPERIMENT ONLY and must not be read as a production distribution decision -- gpt's section 10 draws that line explicitly, and PW-0208 is blocked on precisely the decision it would pre-empt.
